children: announced on Wednesday a major expansion of their U.S. delivery partnership, making Costco
available through the Uber Eats app in 47 states, up from 17 previously. Nearly 600 Costco

warehouses now offer both on-demand and scheduled delivery, allowing members to order groceries, fresh produce, household staples, bulk items, and Costco-exclusive products without visiting a warehouse.
The expansion is aimed at giving Costco

members another convenient way to access the retailer’s selection and member pricing, whether they are planning a large shop, preparing for an event, or handling an immediate need. Customers can use Uber Eats by finding their nearest participating Costco
, selecting products, entering their Costco membership information at checkout, choosing a delivery time, and tracking the order in real time.

The companies are also introducing several member-focused promotions. Eligible Costco members can receive 50% off an annual Uber One membership in the first year and 20% off in later years. For a limited period, participating Costco warehouses and Costco.com will sell $100 Uber or Uber Eats gift cards for $79.99. Consumers can also buy a Costco membership through Uber Eats and receive 30% off their first qualifying Costco order. Meanwhile, Uber One members receive no Uber fees on eligible grocery and retail orders over $60, alongside other membership benefits.
